However…
Doesn't that voice belong to that red #C236196003Lancer#CDEF…?
I wonder if this chanting bothers #C236196003Saber#CDEF?

Hm? This isn't a chant, you know?
It's merely high range noise.
#C236196003Saber#CDEF says so seriously.
That Servant might be some extraordinary diva.
Eh… could this voice belong to #C236196003Red Lancer#CDEF…?

Uwaa! No way! A #C236196003lizard woman#CDEF like her giving
off such a beautiful voice?
The god who made her was way too lenient!

Ugh… The depth of this layer is straining
our memory usage, but there aren't any issues
yet. We can back you up.
There…!
But――

I know.
We have uninvited guests, right?

She has barely any selfishness and behaves rationally.
There's no way she'd set up a Torture Chamber like this――!

#C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF! Please call out to #C236196003Rani#CDEF!
She's undoubtedly being manipulated by #C236196003BB#CDEF!
I'll say this to #C236196003Rani#CDEF―――
Snap out of it, Rani!
Shaddup.
Shaddup!?

Develop #C236196003Lancer#CDEF…? #C236196003Rani#CDEF.
You aren't illegally modding that Servant,
are you?

Losers of the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF are erased by the
#C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF. She summons those on [the verge of
erasure] and seems to offer them to #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.

Yet, what if that second stretched
out to an eternity?

Their body might be tied to the guillotine,
but while being tied, if that second stretched
on for eternity―――
Would they denounce that as "an act of the devil"?
Saying that with a smile is frickin' scary, man!
…hmm. What about this #[piggy][squirrely]#?

I feel like the #C000246204Five Meditations#CDEF
engraved in my left hand faintly rumbled.

Hold! I can't ignore this "personal stage"!
Tell me more…!

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort

We took more damage from our fight with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF

Luckily, there's a #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF near us.

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's #C000246204continue onward#CDEF!

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping
here is impermissible, yes?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
use it to get back here.
I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

There's no doubt about it. There's #C236196003Rani#CDEF,
who was made into the Labyrinth's #C000246204Sentinel#CDEF like #C236196003Rin#CDEF.
And #C236196003Rin#CDEF's former Servant, red #C236196003Lancer#CDEF…!

What are we looking at in this room?
I thought #C236196003Rin#CDEF made it so that the
Torture Chamber for captured Masters and
NPCs was done away with―――

As of chrono-coordinate 2020 07 22,
64 #RUBS   Masters#RUBEdeserters#REND and 23 discarded NPCs were
successfully #RUBS   salvaged#RUBEretrieved#REND.

We will send them off to the Torture Chamber
as new patrons.

Wonderful. You've furnished me with new pigs
again. Well done, #C236196003Rani#CDEF. You're a bit of a wet
blanket, but your work is top-notch.

Naturally. I complete my contracted work.
This is my reason for being; my bliss.
However, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.

Good evening, #[piggy][squirrely]# Master.
I'm so happy to meet you again. Really!
I wouldn't flatter you.

Ho. Glad to meet us again? That's something. But
I know how you feel. I see that high pride of
yours can't stand the constant losing.

Yeah, but I'm getting sick of you. You just
don't learn. Why are you here, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF? Looking
for new pastures in the companion department?

This is a terrible calamity for us.
Please don't show this kind of scene to my
honest and pure Darling.

So you happened to have enough elegance to
celebrate our reunion? I see your skull isn't
filled with evil dragon muscle, at least.

Good answer. Cheeky, impolite, yet so charming.
Such valuable prey you are, I'm so lucky that
your impudence makes you worth pummeling.

Even if I was holding back, a loss is a loss.
#SVT[#C236196003Saber#CDEF][#C236196003Archer#CDEF][#C236196003Caster#CDEF][#C236196003Goldy#CDEF]#. I'll pay you and your Master
back for that disgrace three, no, sixfold.

Even if I was holding back, a loss is a loss.
#SVT[#C236196003Saber#CDEF][#C236196003Archer#CDEF][#C236196003Caster#CDEF][#C236196003Goldy#CDEF]#. I'll pay you and your Master
back for that disgrace three, no, sixfold.

Even if I was holding back, a loss is a loss.
#SVT[#C236196003Saber#CDEF][#C236196003Archer#CDEF][#C236196003Caster#CDEF][#C236196003Goldy#CDEF]#. I'll pay you and your Master
back for that disgrace three, no, sixfold.

Even if I was holding back, a loss is a loss.
#SVT[#C236196003Saber#CDEF][#C236196003Archer#CDEF][#C236196003Caster#CDEF][#C236196003Goldy#CDEF]#. I'll pay you and your Master
back for that disgrace three, no, sixfold.

Sixfold, you say!? …hm, we're agreeing more
and more… Personally, I'm of the opinion that
the more spent, the better. But anyway.

Do you have anything to back up your claim?
Luxury and pretense look similar. Beauties who
try too hard are cute, but there's a limit.

Sixfold is a big claim, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.
But aren't you being just as narrow-minded?
We saw you at your best in our last fight.

Twofold would be enough, but six, you say?
My, what a waste. How are you going to get by
with your household's finances like that?

"Get by" is a mindset that reeks of old people.
In this era, we go all out with our hospitality.
Maybe it's our age difference, fox granny?
――Got it. Baked lizard coming right up. Now.

Ho. "Sixfold" is yet another big claim.
I presume you were the lord of some region.
But is that all you have in your reserves?

Hehe… It looks like you still can't tell how
different the power balance is when you compare
your company to mine.

Behold! My new Torture Chamber! Even when I
was alive, I was never able to manage so
much blood!

Ah… Why is it so fantastic!? A never-ever-
ending, beautiful spring of living pumps!
THIS is what I've wanted: my Salon of Eden!

Last time… when #C236196003Rin#CDEF was my attendant,
I wasn't able to manifest my true power.

But this time it's different. Thanks to #C236196003Rani#CDEF's
perfect mana supply, I've become my true
self again!

#C236196003Lancer#CDEF speaks with elation.
…certainly, the strong pressure she's emanating
is greater than before.

The real issue isn't with the powered-up #C236196003Lancer#CDEF, though.
The opening of a new Torture Chamber is
#C236196003Rani#CDEF's doing.

I don't remember exactly, but #C236196003Rani#CDEF wasn't
that sort of inhuman girl.

She's a homunculus… an artificial being created on Earth.
Similar in some ways to the electronic lives of AI,
but different in others. Her life was manufactured,
but a fragment of it is "human."
There's no more doubt about that.
Sorry for the wait, Rani!
You're really not wearing any, Rani!?

…what a peculiar thing to say. I am sane.
If anyone is being abnormal, it's you all.

I don't understand what you mean, but there's
no need for you to apologize, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.
I'm not particularly angry about anything.

This is the second time you've made
a thoughtless remark. Let's just say that
#C236196003BB#CDEF's objective and mine are one and the same.

I'm the #C000246204Sentinel#CDEF who the Labyrinth was entrusted
to. This you should already have known.
You and I are enemies.

And knowing that, you still stepped into the
Labyrinth? Perhaps, you wish to open
discussions or similar?
#C236196003Rani#CDEF's words cause me great pain.

…I already experienced with #C236196003Rin#CDEF how we
won't be able to talk things through.
I don't expect things to be that easy.

It's just, apart from that, #C236196003Rani#CDEF's tone hurt me.
She hasn't changed at all.

I may have forgotten most of the things I knew
about her, but I feel like she's the type of friend that's
hard to come by. I'm surprised to learn that she's
like this―――

…you haven't come looking to battle, right?
Then please go back.
I don't have time to spare.

I may be the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF #C000246204Sentinel#CDEF,
but it's also my duty to develop #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.

You're wrong. I'm acting as #C236196003Lancer#CDEF's producer
to make her a first-class idol.
That was the condition of our contract.

In order to do that, I was looking up data
on the past #C000246204Holy Grail Wars#CDEF that occurred
in the Near Side of the Moon…

I'm temporarily securing the defeated and
deleted Masters and extracting their resources.

That's horrible… Then, aren't these the people
who were dragged in by #C236196003BB#CDEF!? These humans
were actually alive…!?

Do you think this is inhumane? One second later,
and they would've been deleted by the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF.
Their destiny is to be defeated.

They're briefly held in an Imaginary Number
Space, and their quasi-Spiritrons… the relevant
part of their blood, is harvested. No harm.

They're originally deleted beings. If #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
likes, she can lock them in this prison and
prolong their lives for a momentary eternity.

I will ask you once more.
―――Are there any problems with my actions?
…pressured by #C236196003Rani#CDEF's calm eyes, words don't come out of me.

If I were asked if this goes against everything humane,
there's not a doubt in my mind that it does.

But――what do the Masters who were brought
to this Torture Chamber really think?

For example: they're criminals on the
guillotine, which mercilessly falls,
and they're a second away from death.

That kinda human rights violation has nothing to
do with this! Even #C236196003Leo#CDEF's Western European
conglomerate must hear stuff like that!

Hey, we're a little better than that. Our
employees have the freedom to choose manual
labor or studies. The benefits are good, too.

More importantly, what about the old man!?
Where's old man #C236196003Gatou#CDEF!? Did you already hang
him up in the Torture Chamber!?

#C236196003Gatou#CDEF? Ah, that big man from before.
A boar like him might get muscle in my blood.
No thanks.

It seems that #C236196003Rani#CDEF dealt with him…
What did you do?

I didn't feel like disposing of him
or educating him.

He's a contaminant with negative Prince
Strength. Since he's a pain, I quarantined him
in a corner of the Labyrinth.

If you leave him alone like he is for ten
years, then he might become a cleaner #C236196003Gatou#CDEF.

Ah. That's the "Prince Grading" you're so good
at. You ignore Masters without promise, I think.

Sure. According to my glasses' measurements…
#[His][Her]# Protagonist Power is only five…

Total trash.
Then should we clean things up here nice
and tidy?

…however, with some polish, #[his][her]# great talent
will shine. No, I will make #[him][her]# shine. I have
to bring it out, no matter what.
#C236196003Rani#CDEF's glasses shine with a flash.

Some intense, unpleasant premonition rushes
through my entire body―――

I've decided. We're enacting Plan D.
#C236196003Lancer#CDEF, please send us back for the moment.
I'm going to remake this layer to my liking.

Okay. I'll do as you say, producer. In exchange,
hurry and prepare my personal stage and
thousand-#ROFS-002#RUBS  slave#RUBEmember#REND fanclub.

Stop… is what I want to say, but let's
pull back, too. As long as this Shield is here,
there's no going forward.

Wai―stop, you four-eyed Indian! A Protagonist
Power of five? Those glasses only see the bad
because they're so damn foggy! For sure!

Look like they scurried back home. …hmm.
Our enemy this time is also a woman. Mongrel.
Your escape drama is too unbalanced.

…#C236196003Rani#CDEF and #C236196003Lancer#CDEF ended up transporting
themselves somewhere.

Since the ruler of this Labyrinth is #C236196003Rani#CDEF,
we have no means of chasing after her.

We confirmed that #C236196003Gatou#CDEF is still alive.
Let's try heading back to the old school for
a bit.
I'm inside a deep ocean.

I vaguely remember the ambiance of this floor
as being similar to the Near Side #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF's Arena.

There's just one big difference between this
and the Arena. A chant echoes through the
Labyrinth, like ripples on water.

If I were to close my eyes and strain my ears,
that alone would clear my mind.
It's that sort of beautiful voice.
This singing is so beautiful, though.

Perhaps it's the sound of the wind. Certainly,
it makes me a little sluggish, but it worries me
not. Gods, you are quite high strung.

How can one expect any less from the
self-proclaimed artist who is loved by the goddess
of art. From her perspective, this beautiful
chanting needs a lot of work.

…this voice… Yeah, it's her.
Her personality stinks, but I have to concede
that her voice, at least, is lovely.

There's some truth to #C236196003Archer#CDEF's words.
Like he said, this chanting is beautiful and chaste.

Ho. A good, aesthetic voice. That #C236196003Lancer#CDEF. She's
a dragon girl, albeit diluted. She
has lungs and a throat humans can't obtain.

Being able to control such a wide and high scale
as this makes her quite the singer.
I will have to re-evaluate her now.

Anyhow, this Labyrinth is now under
#C236196003BB#CDEF and her entourages' control.

I'm worried about the new #C000246204Sentinel#CDEF, but I'm also
worried about #C236196003Gatou#CDEF's safety, since he sent us that SOS.

The moment #C236196003#SVT#CDEF gave me a glance to signal
that I should steel myself and march on, a call rang out
from my terminal.

Can you hear me, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF? This is the
Student Council Room. Our monitors and scans are 
both keeping levels normal.

Well done, #C236196003Sakura#CDEF. I hate to keep burdening
you, but please keep the Student Council Room
Sub-Engine going.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. Since #C236196003Gatou#CDEF's distress signal
has ceased, for the time being,
please try moving forward as far as you can.

Since this is a new layer, please take extra
care when fighting. If you feel like you're in
danger, return back through the stairs.

I'm picking up readings on old man #C236196003Gatou#CDEF, so
there's no need to panic. That old man won't go
down no matter how much you kick his bucket.
